overall_reason: The long article reads fully with scripts off, wraps at 375 and lazy-loads its 36 slides, but the slides' words exist only in pictures and the page ships an icon font and a slider library it barely uses.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT, T-WIDTHS and T-HOSTILE-CONTENT pass; T-TRANSLATE fails on the slide images (ROB-011) and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB on unused assets (ROB-018).

findings.title: Room for other languages
findings.where: Pitch deck slides (figure.wp-block-image img, Slide06.jpg and on), 1440px, tiles/1440-09.png
findings.evidence: text_in_images: 15 rows; each slide is a JPEG or PNG whose alt text is only 'LinkedIn Series B Pitch Deck to Greylock: Slide 5', 'Slide 6' and so on. The slide titles, bullets and figures are set in the pictures.
findings.before: The deck's words exist only as pixels.
findings.after: Add each slide's text below its picture, or in a details element beside it.
findings.why: The deck is the subject of the article; translation tools, screen readers and search cannot reach what the slides say.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.where: Material Icons font and Slider Revolution script, all widths
findings.evidence: performance.heaviest: MaterialIcons-Regular.woff2 at 122 KiB while fonts.json drew 2 glyphs from Material Icons; wp-content/plugins/revslider/public/js/sr7.js at 101 KiB on an article with no slider on the tiles. Total known transfer is 3101 KiB (fail over 3000), of which 2450 KiB is the slide images (79%).
findings.before: The theme loads a full icon font and a slider library on every page.
findings.after: Replace the two icons with inline SVG and load the slider script only on pages that have a slider.
findings.why: The slides earn their weight; the 223 KiB of icon font and slider code does not.

strengths: The article reads with scripts off: 47,663 visible characters, the same as the baseline.
36 of the 39 images carry loading="lazy", so a reader pays for slides as they reach them.
Long slashed tokens ('model/criteria/triggers', 'identities/CVs/profiles,') stay inside the 263px column at 375, and the document matches every viewport width.
Money and numbers use one US style ('$0.60', '500,000') under html lang en-US.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names, translations and missing images are reasoned from layout evidence, not observed
right-to-left render: not captured; readiness read from the stylesheet only
page load on a throttled line: only actions were held slow
layout shift as a number: this capture predates CLS recording
computed text-overflow per element: absent in this capture; ellipsis rows come from class rules and were checked on tiles
widths between the captures, 320px and landscape
regions behind menus, tabs, dialogs or a login that the capture did not open
36 images were blocked by the capture network at some width (not verified); the tiles show the slides drawn
T-FAILURE-PATH: async found no primary actions
the 'Skip to content' link reads as clipped because it is screen-reader text until focused
contract: no 00-contract.md; inferred a Read long-form article, English (US)
